name: strike-everywhere
description: Embeddable Strike perps trading for any Cardano app: widget + SDK + partner dashboard, built on Strike Builder Connect.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @strike-everywhere/core && npm run build -w @strike-everywhere/widget
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @strike-everywhere/core && npm run typecheck -w @strike-everywhere/widget
scripts.deploy:site: npm run site && npx --yes wrangler@3.84.1 pages deploy site --project-name strike-everywhere --branch main --commit-dirty=true
